decision: Approve a separate two-point, source-native Economic Census series for JSIC 3914 Game software industry establishment persons engaged.
series_definition: National establishment-industry tabulation for JSIC 3914 Game software industry. It covers establishments creating game software, including component programs, for home-TV consoles, portable electronic games and PCs, plus related research, analysis and advice. It excludes game-cassette and game-optical-disc manufacturing. It is neither all staff of diversified game publishers/hardware companies nor an occupation, contractor, or FTE series.
trend_conditions: Use only the two dated required-items establishment-tabulation points, label the exact reference dates and persons-engaged unit, and describe the change as a two-point classified-establishment comparison. Do not interpolate a yearly path or imply a post-2016 continuation.

primary_evidence.locator: PDF p. 2 / printed p. 1, Table I-1, row 3914 ゲームソフトウェア業
primary_evidence.direct_evidence: The row reports 246 establishments and 9,452 workers; its table note says establishments, workers and sales are tabulated only for establishments with values for required items.

primary_evidence.locator: Table 1 national row 3914 ゲームソフトウェア業
primary_evidence.direct_evidence: The official download row reports 256 establishments and 18,216 persons engaged. The official results overview, https://www.stat.go.jp/data/e-census/2016/kekka/pdf/r_serviceb.pdf, p. 2 notes the 1 June 2016 reference date and excludes management/support-only establishments and establishments without industry-specific-item values.

permissible_join: country/JP.json contains no existing JP_census_3914_required_items record. Add this new series definition and only these two observations as a separate series; do not attach either value to an existing JP series or use it as the preferred CESA observation.
forbidden_joins: Do not join to JP_core_range or JP_broad. CESA's public estimates are undated, include console hardware in the core range, and broaden further to peripherals, distribution, retail, amusement, toys and media.
Do not join to JP_status_2024, JP_status_2025, JP_freelancers_2024, or JP_freelancers_2025. CEDEC values are voluntary respondent shares, not national workforce stocks.
Do not fill unobserved annual or post-2016 gaps, substitute a 2021 middle-classification/software/service table, or portray the 2016 value as a 2021 count.

Do not join to METI Information and Communications Industry Basic Survey values. That enterprise survey is main-industry based and has a distinct enterprise universe and worker-status treatment; it is outside this review.
